correctness.rationale: Atomic singular-vector truncations give the upper approximation bound and finite-dimensional lower witnesses give matching approximation/Bernstein/Gelfand bounds. A fixed-vector nonatomic Lp subspace supplies the continuous norm floor. Reflexive Bochner duality gives the Kolmogorov equality, and infinite-dimensional bounded-below witnesses give the exact distance to compact/FSS/SS classes.

originality.rationale: Classical atomless scalar multiplication and scalar/vector-valued diagonal approximation results are explicitly treated as prior art. The inspected literature did not identify the simultaneous four-s-number formula for finite matrix-valued multiplication on mixed sigma-finite Bochner Lp spaces together with the exact compact/FSS/SS distance. Older diagonal and direct-integral sources, including Heymann's 2015 thesis, remain a documented residual risk.

value.rationale: A single explicit invariant completely determines four finite-dimensional approximation scales and three operator-ideal distances, unifying atomic and nonatomic multiplication behavior and showing p-independence for all 1<p<infinity.
